description: Dense iridescent alloy ingot forged from Blightstone, gold, and iron.
lore: 'Impervious to heat, acid, and crushing weight.'

description: A primordial runic stone. Apply to Legendary or Ancient gear with an open affix slot to awaken god-tier affixes!
lore: 'Pulsating with forgotten cosmic inscriptions that alter the nature of arms.'

description: Brass burner and glassware condenser stand for concocting high-tier alchemical solutions.
lore: 'Condensing the essence of stars into restorative drops.'

description: Lever-action mechanised arbalest delivering high-velocity armor-piercing bolts.
lore: 'Crank, lock, release—calibrated for merciless distance.'

description: Painted straw bullseye target for measuring marksmanship and projectile distance.

lore: 'The abyss yields its greatest secrets to celestial craft.'

lore: 'Traditional tool of the industrious Filipino magsasaka.'

description: Crafting material or component.
Hardened purple stone from the Blight that requires high-tier pickaxes to mine.

description: Remnants of subterranean dungeon skeletons. Used to craft bows and armor.
lore: 'Hardened by centuries in the dark.'

description: Reinforced skeletal recurve bow with formidable arrow velocity.

description: Sturdy wooden shelves lined with leather-bound arcane tomes and recipes.

description: Whimsically hollowed giant potato grinning merrily with a warm flame burning inside.

description: Starlight particulate dropped by Celestial Titan Sol-Rho.

description: Grand hanging ceiling chandelier fitted with four glowing candles.

description: Broad cutting arc capable of keeping creeping slimes at bay.

lore: 'A spud with a blade is never to be underestimated.'

description: A crackling cobblestone fire pit radiating gentle light and soothing campfire smoke.

lore: 'Frost clings to the air around this enchanted relic.'

description: Right-click to teleport to the Arid Waste Arena to summon Ignis Colossus!
lore: 'The heat within this stone burns like the noonday desert sun.'

description: Rich fertile earth. Right-click to place. Sprouts fresh grass when exposed to sun.

description: Compact oiled satchel that keeps field specimens and minerals neatly organized.

lore: 'A fragment of pure starlight plucked from the night sky.'

description: Ignited arrow tipped with torch flame and sap. Burns targets on hit.

description: Place on the ground. Stand near it to smelt raw ores into ingots and cook savory potato meals.

description: Bioluminescent tipped arrows that pierce shadows and illuminate hit adversaries.

description: Lustrous gold axe with unmatched cutting velocity. Cleaves wood in seconds.

description: Gleaming golden veins buried in deep caverns. Smelt at a furnace.
lore: 'A precious vein untouched by sunlight.'

description: Lustrous gilded pickaxe boasting exceptional digging speed.

description: Distilled glowing mushroom tonic that rapidly seals deep wounds.

description: Terracotta architectural shingles for high-angle rooftops.

description: Stout wooden storage cask sealed with copper banding for keeping cellar preserves.

lore: 'Watch your step across the frozen caves.'

description: Hardened iron lumber axe. Swiftly fells towering trees and dense trunks.

description: Heavy cast kettle for collecting rainwater, washing ore, and boiling root broths.

description: Sturdy forged iron hoe that tills soil with effortless precision.
lore: 'Built to endure generations of paddy cultivation.'

description: Durable iron deposits found in underground stone. Smelt at a furnace.

description: Tempered iron head that swiftly breaks through dense stone and minerals.

description: Floating magnetite compass that attunes to deep underground geological anomalies.

description: Rotary iron cutting wheel for cleanly trimming stone blocks into precision architectural trim.

lore: 'Vibrant tessellations that shimmer in the warm torchlight.'

description: Right-click to teleport to the Shadow Crypt to summon Necro-Tuber!

description: Legendary sovereign trident-rod commanding the tides. Reqs supreme mastery to reel mythical relics.
lore: 'Rule the waters, harvest the boundless cosmos.'

description: Phosphorescent brew infused with starlight and spores, enhancing subterranean clarity.
lore: 'The dark caves unveil their deepest secrets to eyes unclouded by shadows.'

description: Iron-bossed oak roundshield that absorbs stray arrows and monster charges.

description: Gilded framed oil landscape portraying rolling potato hills under a sunset.

description: Knotted fiber ladder rungs for swiftly ascending vertical cliffs and shafts.

description: Naturally compressed desert stone.
lore: 'The hardened core of ancient desert dunes.'

description: Valuable silver coin worth 100 Copper Coins.

description: Lightweight shoulder quiver that improves archer draw speed and critical precision.

description: Common subterranean rock. Right-click to place.

description: Heavy reinforced masonry backdrop for fortresses and castles.
